groups.interpretation: Input trigger index and Reaction; intended exact freeze is conditional on lower coverage.
Read trigger main timestamp by position before virtual A14; returned confirmation may be Break-open fallback; reversed range returns null before A08.
A08 inclusive extrema, reorder price/index/time to index/time/price; empty lower coarse containing-main fallback may contain later prices.
Fresh local output, cycle=-1, reuse=null, offset=0; no supplied state-list validation.
Adjacent valid-state pair; bridge iff nonnull retained ordinal equals previous ordinal, not physical identity.
Current consumed condition first, otherwise previous consumed and not bridge. Clear reuse only on skipped bridge pair; advance one.
Expiry from next-next valid state formation, not full Blue ordinal. Null virtual trigger advances without clearing reuse.
Unpack eight trigger fields including effective stop main times distinct from actual state.
A15 exact trigger and max effective stop mains inclusive First gate; null match breaks whole loop. Original Reaction retained.
Null A17 advances without clearing reuse; success unpacks source then converts Break index.
Virtual A21 before append; retain original line source times, full ordinals, effective stop mains and actual state stop levels.
Frozen continuation, trigger, matched ordinal; fresh First positional read, Break timestamp using converted Break; source tuple; required reads may fail before append.
Route ordinary; copy exact stop only on actual/effective main equality, not causal proof. Append before cycle update.
Set frontier to matched Break, recompute virtual A14 and A07 strict stop from returned confirmation unbounded. Failure after local append propagates; no partial list returned.
Reuse iff stop nonnull, next-next state exists and formation>=exact stop; equality allowed. Retain current ordinal then advance one.

Else clear reuse and skip while offset in bounds and formation<=new Break. No unconditional increment; if previous formation>Break, offset may remain unchanged. Native invariant conditional, arbitrary state termination not proven. Return detection-order list.

findings.meaning: Clarify source freeze fallback, next-next valid expiry/reuse, retained bridge on rejected paths, exact stop provenance equality and append-before-reuse failure.

No unconditional increment at 726–731. Under coherent ordered main chronology, valid formation mapping, actual stops not earlier than their formations, crossing at/after start, aligned Reaction confirmation within its own Break main and unchanged caches, each successful route has trigger at/after previous formation: inherited/early formation route starts current formation (later than previous under inheritance; early guard plus actual previous stop), early actual-stop starts current stop; remaining route uses later actual stop or crossing from it. Then matched confirmation>=trigger implies Break position>=previous formation. This is a sufficient conditional argument, not proof of all native creator/consumer, duplicate time, gap/position, fallback or live cache invariants. Retain OPEN, not proven runtime defect.
